title: Localization orthogonality for derived internal Hom
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe, let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, and let $f$ be a global section. Write $\mathcal O_f$ for the sheafified sectionwise localization [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-section-localization], and use the unbounded derived categories of $\mathcal O$-modules and $\mathcal O_f$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For $K\in D(\mathcal O)$ and $L\in D(\mathcal O_f)$, viewed as an $\mathcal O$-complex by restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], there is a natural isomorphism $$R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(L,K)\cong R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_f}(L,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal O_f,K)).$$ Consequently, if $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal O_f,K)=0$, then $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(L,K)=0$ for every $L\in D(\mathcal O_f)$. No boundedness, finite-generation, or flatness hypothesis is imposed.
